welcome_desc:
Fully integrated with Godot 4.7. It can generate files and code, manage scenes, debug live and clarify architecture.

Pick one of the quick-start tasks below or type your question directly in the box below:
hint_temperature: Controls model randomness. Lower values produce more consistent code. Mouse wheel is disabled to prevent accidental changes.
hint_max_steps: Maximum number of autonomous tool steps allowed per user request.
hint_language: Language used across sidebar UI, approval dialogs, and notices.
hint_approval_mode: Controls approval gate behavior for file mutation and deletion.
hint_provider_agy: Google Antigravity CLI uses your local session directly. No third-party proxy/MITM; no API key or base URL needed.
hint_provider_openai: OpenAI-compatible local or cloud API endpoint (9Router, Ollama, OpenRouter, etc.).
tooltip_paused: Type 'devam et' to continue. Any other message starts a new task.
settings_stream_hint: OpenAI-compatible provider: show the answer as it is generated. Turn it off if your endpoint does not support streaming.
settings_vision_hint: Screenshots are sent to the model only if it accepts images. Override the automatic guess if it is wrong for your model.
settings_require_delete: Ask before deleting a node or file
settings_require_overwrite: Ask before overwriting an existing file
settings_approvals_hint: Apply in Manual mode (deleting also in Auto mode). Full Auto never asks.
mcp_settings_port_saved: Port saved. If the bridge was on, it restarted on the new port; add the connection again in your agent with the copied command.
custom_usage_hint: What rules, skills and tool definitions add to the model's context on every turn (approximate: characters / 4). Tools show the full catalog; each turn sends only the relevant subset.
custom_rules_truncated: Rules are longer than {max} characters and are truncated; move procedures into skills.
custom_rules_hint: Always-on instructions sent on every turn. Global rules (~/.agents/AGENTS.md, ~/.agents/rules/*.md) apply to all your projects; project rules (AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, .agents/AGENTS.md, .agents/rules/*.md) travel with the game repository and are read by other agents too. Use @rules in a message to stress them, /learn to save a new rule.
custom_rule_placeholder: New rule, one sentence (e.g. Keep province data in data/*.json)
mcp_settings_hint: Lets external agents such as Claude Code, Cursor or Codex use this editor over MCP: read scenes, run the game, read runtime errors, take screenshots, send input and make small undoable scene edits. It listens only on this computer (127.0.0.1) and needs a secret token. The same controls are available as /mcp on, /mcp off.
mcp_settings_unavailable: The bridge is only available while the plugin is enabled in the editor.
mcp_settings_copied: Copied. Paste it in a terminal in your game project folder.
mcp_settings_start_failed: Could not listen on port {port} (error {error}); another program may be using it.
skills_hint: Skills are reusable instruction packages (Agent Skills standard, SKILL.md). The agent sees the names and descriptions of enabled skills and loads one when a task matches; you can also start one with /skill name. Project skills come from the repository and stay off until you enable them.

settings_endpoint_hint: Used only by the OpenAI-compatible provider; Antigravity CLI uses the local session and needs none of these.
rules_builtin_hint: The plugin's own working method, sent first on every turn. The global and project rules below are added on top and win on conflict. After a plugin update, press Restore default to get the new default.
mcp_settings_connect_hint: Run the command in a terminal in your game project folder. The token is masked here; the copied command has it in full.
settings_ui_animations_hint: New cards and pages fade in briefly. Turn off to reduce motion.
settings_goal_hint: With a goal set by /goal, the agent reports its status at the end of every round and keeps going on its own until the goal is met with evidence, it is blocked, or this round limit is reached. Each round uses its own step limit (the setting above).
goal_banner_stop_tooltip: Ends the goal and stops the running round.
goal_none: No active goal. To start one: `/goal your goal` (e.g. `/goal the player can jump and dies when falling`).
goal_status_active:
**Active goal:** {objective}

Round {round} / {max}. To stop: `/goal stop` or Stop on the goal strip.
goal_already_active: A goal is already active: {objective}. Stop it with `/goal stop` before starting a new one.
goal_busy: A new goal cannot start while the agent is running. Wait for the task to finish or stop it.
cmd_desc_help: Shows the commands, what they do and how to use them. The same list is in the Help button in the header.
cmd_desc_clear: Clears the chat (same as the Clear button): the screen, the agent context and the session content.
cmd_desc_analyze: Analyzes the project or scene; changes no files.
cmd_desc_inspect: Inspects the active scene, the node tree or the given target (node name or res:// path).
cmd_desc_test: Runs the relevant tests and code checks and interprets the result.
cmd_desc_run: Runs the game and reports runtime errors and state.
cmd_desc_debug: Analyzes editor and runtime logs, errors and the stack trace.
cmd_desc_fix: Tries to fix the last error found, safely.
cmd_desc_review: Reviews the latest changes against safety and quality criteria.
cmd_desc_explain: Explains the given file, node or the latest changes (`last`).
cmd_desc_skill: Lists skills, or loads the chosen skill's instructions and starts the task with it. Manage them with the Skills button in the header.
cmd_desc_learn: Teaches a permanent rule: `/learn rule` turns it into one clear rule and saves it; `/learn` alone proposes rules from the corrections in this chat. Project rule by default, `--global` for all projects. Asks before saving.
cmd_desc_mcp: External agent bridge (MCP): lets agents such as Claude Code use this editor, and gives the connection command.
cmd_desc_goal: Goal mode: the agent works round by round until the goal is met with evidence. `/goal` shows the status, `/goal stop` stops it.
help_start_hint: The sidebar is an AI agent inside the Godot editor: it reads your request, carries it out with file and scene tools, then runs the game and checks the result.
help_start_1: 1. Pick where the AI comes from in Settings > Provider (Antigravity CLI or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint), then choose the model in the top bar.
help_start_2: 2. Type the task in plain language in the box below (e.g. "Add a double jump to the player") and press Enter.
help_start_3: 3. Risky actions show an approval card; the approval mode button in the top bar sets how often it asks.
help_start_4: 4. Every change goes into the editor's undo history: press Ctrl+Z to revert.
help_commands_hint: Type / in the box to open the list; move with ↑ ↓ and complete with Enter or Tab. Commands are only shortcuts: every feature is also reachable from the interface.
help_mentions_hint: Type @ in the box to open the list. What you mention is added to that request's context.
help_mention_file: Adds a project file's content to the request (res:// path or file name).
help_mention_node: Adds a node from the open scene to the request.
help_mention_rules: Makes the loaded rules apply strictly to this request.
help_mention_skill: Does this request with the given skill's instructions.
help_key_enter: Send (queued if the agent is running).
help_key_paste: Attaches the image on the clipboard (sent if the model supports images).
help_key_undo: Reverts the agent's last change in the editor.
help_modes_hint: The mode button in the top bar or Settings > General.
help_more_resume: To resume a stopped task, type just "continue" (or "devam").
help_more_queue: What you type while the agent runs is queued; cancel a queued request with ×.
help_more_goal: Give a goal with /goal: the agent works round by round until it is met with evidence; end it with Stop on the goal strip.
help_more_rules: Rules and skills: Settings > Rules and Skills (or /learn, /skill).
help_more_history: History, export and copy: the buttons in the header.
help_more_mcp: Connect external agents such as Claude Code: Settings > External Agent (MCP) or /mcp.
help_guide_hint: The step-by-step user guide with every feature, setting and examples is on GitHub.
help_more_link: Summary: the Help (?) button in the header.
approval_hint_delete_file: The file is deleted from disk; this cannot be undone.
approval_hint_delete_node: The node is removed from the open scene; Ctrl+Z can undo it.
approval_hint_edit: Check it with View Diff before approving; the Changes card can undo it.
approval_hint_add_rule: The rule applies to every future task.
config_restored_missing: **The settings file was missing** and was restored from the last backup (config.json.bak); your settings are kept. To reset on purpose, delete config.json and config.json.bak together.
config_restored_corrupt: **The settings file was corrupt** and was restored from the last backup (config.json.bak); your settings are kept. The broken file is kept as config.json.corrupt for inspection.
agent_state_answer_received: Got your answer, continuing the task...
agent_state_heal_failed: The same runtime error could not be fixed.
agent_state_empty: The model returned an empty response.
agent_error_empty: The model returned an empty response (PROVIDER_EMPTY_RESPONSE).
agent_state_repeated: The same tool ({tool}) was called repeatedly.
agent_error_repeated: The agent repeated the same tool ({tool}). Task stopped.
agent_reason_repeated: The agent repeated the same tool ({tool}).
agent_state_network_retry: Temporary network / empty response error, retrying...
prompt_image_only: Look at this image and help.
slash_unknown_hint: Type `/help` to see the available commands.
provider_agy_start_failed: Could not start Antigravity CLI ('agy'). Make sure 'agy' is on the system PATH and you are signed in.
provider_agy_init_failed: Could not start Antigravity CLI ('agy') (init did not complete).
provider_agy_pipe_failed: Could not connect to the Antigravity CLI stdio pipe.
provider_agy_no_vision: The Antigravity CLI (agy) provider does not accept image (Vision) input yet. For image analysis, choose the OpenAI-compatible provider (9Router/OpenRouter/Ollama) in Settings.
provider_no_vision: The current provider or selected model does not support images (Vision).
provider_model_no_vision: The selected model ({model}) does not support images (Vision).
net_connection_closed: Connection closed (the server did not respond or the response was incomplete).
net_auth_failed: Authorization error (HTTP 401): check your API key.
provider_server_empty: The server returned an empty response (PROVIDER_EMPTY_RESPONSE).
provider_model_empty: The model returned an empty response (PROVIDER_EMPTY_RESPONSE). Check the model selection or API parameters.
cmd_desc_bug: Opens the bug report window: builds a local report package with environment info, masked settings, the chat log, the log tail and a panel screenshot; nothing is sent anywhere.
bug_card_hint: If something went wrong, one report package is prepared with environment info, the chat log and a panel screenshot. The package is created only on your computer; you attach it to a GitHub issue yourself.
bug_what_hint: What were you doing, what did you expect, what happened? Steps make the bug much easier to find.
bug_what_placeholder: E.g. I set a goal with /goal and the panel froze in the second round…
bug_parts_hint: Every report includes the plugin / Godot / system versions and a safe summary of your settings. API keys and tokens are never written (only whether they are set); secret patterns in the chat and log are masked.
bug_part_log: Last lines of the game log
bug_result_hint: The issue text is on the clipboard. Open a new issue on GitHub, paste the text and drag the zip file in.
bug_md_attachment_hint: Report package: `{file}` (attach it to this issue).
